annotations.title: Get a US air passenger right, with sources

description: US airline passenger rights: the federal rule for one topic (for example refunds when a flight is cancelled, denied boarding, tarmac delays, the 24-hour rule, lost bags, wheelchairs), questions a passenger can raise with the airline, citations and a current-as-of date. It states rules only; it does not calculate bump payment amounts or explain ticket codes. Input: one topic id only; names, confirmation codes, ticket numbers and frequent flyer numbers aren't needed or used.

topic.description: Topic id; the allowed ids are the values listed in this schema.
